- **E0091** (poem, sure): 御製蒨園八景詩. 1753 (乾隆十八年) · j83:8a-9a · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_083.txt
  > 乾隆十八年御製蒨園八景詩　一亭一沼爰静神逰之鄉非壑非林自足天成之趣此中大有佳處物外聊爾寄情不為嵩山之比方偶效右丞之格調　機緘合希夷水木呈明翠銀塘横半𤱔萬頃煙波意（右朗潤齋）　樓臨内外湖地髙望斯逺湛然虚且明絜矩出治本（右湛景樓）　風前度彌静雨後香益清倣彿吳興岸菱歌唱晩晴（右菱香沜）　藍瑛碑側石名之青蓮朶介示無去來黙傳忘物我（右青蓮朶）總此一大内謾稱别有天達人誚坐井匪我古已然（右别有天）　石激出淙乳儼中宫商音我不觧攫醳而愛韻天琴（右韻天琴）　笠亭據假山亦足云標勝設擬宣城蹟合得謫仙詠（右標勝亭）　境以曲折幽中宏延外廣尺宅含寸田至人貴知養（右委宛藏）
  Eight short poems on 蒨園: 朗潤齋, 湛景樓, 菱香沜, 青蓮朶, 别有天, 韻天琴, 標勝亭 and 委宛藏.
- **E0092** (poem, sure): 御製重摹梅石碑置青蓮朶側而系之詩（有序）. 1767 (乾隆三十二年) · j83:7b-8a · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_083.txt
  > 乾隆三十二年御製重摹梅石碑置青蓮朶側而系之詩（有序）　乙酉冬曽摹徳夀宫梅石碑驛致杭州以留舊跡因思梅既乆枯石又北來則新碑與舊碑不過存其名於依稀髣髴間耳既又思梅之槁於南者雖不可復生而石之存於北者固在也因命重摹一通置之石側青蓮朶者盖壬申初到時所命名亦並有詩紀事云　昔年德夀石名曰青蓮朶梅枯石北來惟餘碑尚妥徳夀豈復存乆矣燬兵火不禁興廢感碑亦漫漶頗因之為橅蹟驛致江之左新碑鄰舊碑那見梅石我重摹置石側為結無緣果誰云假氷玉猶是真嶪峩如因憶中郎武賁何不可
  Poem with preface: the 梅石碑 from the old 德壽宫 in Hangzhou. The stone itself had come north as 青蓮朶; he made a second copy of the stele to set beside it.
- **E0103** (text, sure): 日下舊聞考 蒨园. 1780s (乾隆 敕撰) · j83:7a-7b · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_083.txt
  > 澹懐堂迤西濵河水石之間為蒨園門西嚮内為朗潤齋三楹其東為湛景樓又東為菱香沜朗潤齋西有石立於園門内為青蓮朶齋東南山池間為標勝亭又東南為别有天西北為韻天琴南角門外别院為委宛藏（長春園册）臣等謹案蒨園門左碑亭一刋重摹梅石碑標勝亭西壁勒御製蒨園八景詩
  West of 澹懐堂: the west-facing gate of 蒨園 with the three-bay 朗潤齋, 湛景樓, 菱香沜, the rock 青蓮朶, 標勝亭, 别有天, 韻天琴 and 委宛藏. A stele pavilion by the gate holds the re-engraved 梅石碑, and 蒨園八景詩 are cut on the west wall of 標勝亭.

  > 小园临绿水，曲径引藤萝。奇石如蹲虎，危峰若旋螺。林深沿涧壑，境僻过坡陀。布景最幽蒨，得来画意多。

- **E0096** (poem, sure): 蒨园: 嘉庆十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆十三年 (1808), date from the compilation · p.292 item (5), under 蒨园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=292
  > 黑云冥漠隐亭台，林外横排急雨来。石骨淋漓秀含砌，松梢飞洒翠浮苔。悬河百道倾檐角，涨浦三篙拍岸隈。倏度前溪闻断续，天光澄洁雾徐开。

  > 十笏容膝安，曲廊达疏牖。芸编座右珍，远胜珠玉薮。委宛列琅函，藏修业培厚。御苑富琳琅，奚用访二酉。
  Poem 委宛藏 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1809, filed by the editors under 蒨园.
- **E0097** (poem, sure): 蒨园: 嘉庆十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆十五年 (1810), date from the compilation · p.292 item (7), under 蒨园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=292
  > 堂临川上接清浔，水面风来暑不侵。柳蘸汀头绿波漾，松翻亭角翠涛深。花光掩映拖轻藓，石韵瑽琤潄暗琴。一碧连霄远尘埃，卷阿静赏契予心。
  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1810, on escaping the heat. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0098** (poem, sure): 蒨园: 嘉庆十六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆十六年 (1811), date from the compilation · p.292 item (8), under 蒨园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=292
  > 堂名沿山庄，额同境迥异。彼谓山体言，此喻水之义。静实仁者根，动则用才智。能动静合宜，造极非二事。乾刚运八埏，坤宁镇大地。得一契涵三，妙理蕴精粹。
  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1811, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0099** (poem, sure): 蒨园: 嘉庆十九年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆十九年 (1814), date from the compilation · p.292 item (9), under 蒨园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=292
  > 山庄在崖端，御园依水置。悦性察鸢鱼，观文见仁智。彼必跋马登，此则乘舟至。劳逸大不同，境岂因心易。晏安警勿耽，懈弛最误事。息民非惰荒，力勤常励志。凉雨生凉秋，雨细润滴绿杨。矶益洽豆花，秀倍添谷穗。肥织波烟羃，葱笼树影依稀。植物荷沾溉，西成溥近畿。
  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1814, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0100** (poem, sure): 蒨园: 嘉庆二十一年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆二十一年 (1816), date from the compilation · p.292 item (10), under 蒨园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=292
  > 山庄御苑客相同，即景抒思一贯通。艮止坎流随动静，见仁见智理无穷。临水虗堂碧鉴开，波光印槛净浮埃。静中偶会浚源道，一勺澄泓万派该。
  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1816, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0101** (poem, sure): 蒨园: 嘉庆二十三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆二十三年 (1818), date from the compilation · p.292 item (11), under 蒨园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=292
  > 石径玲珑接曲廊，碧溪一带绕书堂。庭多乔木舒清荫，几有芸编挹古香。心望和甘润畎亩，政求平治守纲常。候临永夏盼嘉泽，播种大田祈稔穰。
  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 蒨园, 1818, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0102** (poem, sure): 蒨园: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor. 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation · p.292 item (13), under 蒨园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=292
  > 偶移画舫访林泉，林碧泉清雨后天。面水虚堂增爽籁，沿山曲径幻云烟。葱茏众绿深而窈，点染余青静且便。芦荻疎疎连岸角，生机活泼悟鱼鸢。
  Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 蒨园, 1823, on boating and the view. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0494** (description, guess): 长春园 Changchun Yuan: eight chief groups. 1934 · p.98 · S02. https://archive.org/details/historyofpekings00malo
  > The new garden which the Emperor constructed in 1751 just east of the Yuan Ming Yuan he called the Ch'ang Ch'un Yuan, or Garden of Long Spring.
  From Rixia j83. Built 1751 by Malone's date, added to for years; about a third of the size of the Yuan Ming Yuan proper; islands and artificial hills with wider spaces and larger lakes. No.1 audience hall inside the south gate (澹怀堂); No.2 palace on the central island (含经堂); Nos.3, 6, 8 lakeside gardens; Nos.4, 5, 7 palace groups on islands. Mapping of numbers to ids is mine; only 6 and 8 are named by Malone.

  Scenes with only scattered, incomplete building remains in the same table. 方壶胜境 is listed separately as the one with fairly complete remains not yet tidied up. 紫碧山房, 舍卫城 and 如园 have been dug since.
- **E0104** (description, sure): 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 蒨园. 1753-1823 · from p.291, under 蒨园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=291
  Qianlong named eight scenes in 1753 (朗润斋, 湛景楼, 菱香沜, 青莲朵, 别有天, 韵天琴, 标胜亭, 委宛藏). Jiaqing named four in 1809 (虚受轩, 委宛藏, 碧静堂, 菱香沜) and returned to 碧静堂 until 1819, so the compound changed. 蒨园: 13 dated items, 1753-1823, of which 11 poems and 2 court records (Qianlong, Jiaqing, Daoguang); recurring themes: the view, rain, escaping the heat. First dated 1753, last dated 1823.

  Begun 1752, its south-east much rebuilt about 1808, when the five-bay 碧静堂 was made. 青莲朵 is the rock from 德寿宫 in Hangzhou. Three gates: a west land gate, a seven-bay north water gate with a landing, and 蒨园门, the only way through to 绮春园.

  海岳开襟: lake islet about 90 m across, about 1,000 m2 of buildings, by 1747, repaired 1778 and 1791; a totem park stood here 1995-2007. 映清斋: added 1766 as a new palace of 玉玲珑馆. 蒨园: 6,600 m2, 2,300 m2 of buildings, 1752. 鉴园: repaired 1810. 狮子林: west part with 丛芳榭 by 1747, the east in imitation of Suzhou finished 1772.
- **E0106** (drawing, sure): 蒨园总平面图. 嘉庆十三年 (1808) · 国家图书馆善本部 样067-1号 · S310. https://www.mhymy.com/dasl/ysltd/7750.html
  Ink base plan of the Qian Yuan garden of 1808. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 蒨园门 on the south gate. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
